svg.title: Wonderland RV, Build your Caravan, Step 2: Size (375 x 812)
svg.desc: Phone layout, 24px page margins. Gradient stops: #FFC47F, #E37921 (52%), #B04C07. Fonts: Aviano Sans Black / Bold, Gordita Regular. Layers: header, progress road, heading, size options, scale, back. A hidden layer shows Mid-size in its hover/selected state.
